{{Quote|<nowiki />''[&hellip;]'' Neo-Crusaders ravaged Nouane, whose elegant civilization and ancient mastery of statecraft epitomized all they despised.|Vilnau Tept, 412th Proceedings of Galactic Anthropology and History|<ref name="EGTW" />}}
'''Nouane''' was an [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] [[Merchant/Legends|trade]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] and the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Nouane (Allied Region)|Nouane]] region. It had famous [[Library/Legends|libraries]] and a long tradition of skillful statecraft. Originally the center of a small state separate from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], it was [[Battle of Nouane|ravaged]] by the [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders]] during the [[Mandalorian Wars]], which prompted the region to seek the protection of the Republic and eventually became one of its [[Allied Region]]s. Later, Nouane became part of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] but afterward remained independent from its successor, the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].

==Description==
Nouane was a terrestrial<ref name="Codex" /> [[Planet/Legends|world]] located in the [[Nouane system/Legends|Nouane system]], a part of the [[Nouane (Allied Region)|Nouane]] region in the [[Northern Dependencies/Legends|Northern Dependencies]] portion of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]. Around [[22,000 BBY/Legends|22,000 BBY]], a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] linked Nouane to the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies']] [[Uviuy Exen system/Legends|Uviuy Exen]] and [[Yabol Opa system/Legends|Yabol Opa systems]].<ref name="TEA" /> Around [[17,000 BBY|five millennia]] later, [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] routes also connected it to the [[Bogden system/Legends|Bogden]], [[Perave system|Perave]], [[Serroco system/Legends|Serroco]], and [[Tirahnn system/Legends|Tirahnn systems]].<ref name="EGTW" /> That group of hyperlanes existed at least until the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]] of [[3996 BBY]] but were no longer in existence by the beginning of the [[Mandalorian Wars]] in [[3976 BBY]].<ref name="TEA" />

==History==
===Independence and suffering===
[[Realspace/Legends|Space]] surrounding Nouane was [[Scout/Legends|explored]] between [[25,000 BBY/Legends|25,000 BBY]] and [[20,000 BBY/Legends|20,000 BBY]]. Nouane was the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of what was originally a prosperous mini-empire of the same name, and it lay outside the borders of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] around 22,000 [['ABY-BBY' dating system/Legends|BBY]].<ref name="TEA" /> The Republic's territory did grow to engulf Nouane by approximately 17,000 BBY, and between that [[Standard year/Legends|year]] and around [[12,000 BBY/Legends|12,000 BBY]], it lay along hyperlanes controlled by the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] planet [[Alsakan/Legends|Alsakan]] and its allies in their [[Alsakan Conflicts/Legends|political struggle]] against the Republic capital world [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="EGTW" />

[[File:NouaneMandalorianWars-TEA.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Nouane was ravaged by a Mandalorian attack during the Mandalorian Wars.]]
In [[3963 BBY]], the [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorian Neo-Crusader]] faction of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] warrior culture invaded Republic territory as part of the Mandalorian Wars,<ref name="TEA" /> [[Battle of Nouane|ravaging]] Nouane.<ref name="EGTW" /> The region's suffering prompted it to seek the Republic's protection, and it became an [[Allied Region]] of that state.<ref name="TEA" /> According to rumors in circulation more than three [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] later, during the ongoing [[Sith Wars/Legends|struggle]] between the Republic and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstitued Sith Empire]], a [[Shebs|unit]] of the [[HK-24 series assassin droid]] model&mdash;which had been advertised by its manufacturer, the [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]], to various Republic planetary governments in the face of the Neo-Crusader threat&mdash;that had been apprehended by Republic authorities for harassing civilians on Nouane was eventually [[Prisoner/Legends|incarcerated]] on the [[Prison/Legends|prison]] world [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]].<ref name="Codex" />

===Further galactic relations===
Nouane was situated in the territories either unaligned with or [[New Sith Wars|contested]] by the Republic and the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] faction known as the [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Brotherhood of Darkness]] by [[1004 BBY]], with the extent of the former having been greatly reduced. Nouane had returned into the fold of the Republic by the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], however,<ref name="TEA" /> and during the first campaigns of that conflict in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the Republic's [[Third Mid Rim Army|Third Sector Army]] was charged with engaging the [[Confederacy military/Legends|military forces]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] in the world's vicinity.<ref name="EGTW" />

[[File:Nouane.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Nouane was the capital of the Nouane region, which at various times was both a part of and independent of larger galactic states.]]
By [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]], Nouane had been incorporated into the territory controlled by the Republic's successor, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="EGTW" /> After the Empire's fall in the wake of the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]<ref name="TEA" /> of [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="EGTW" /> the Nouane region declared its independence,<ref name="TEA" /> and it stood apart from the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], the next central [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] state, by [[17 ABY/Legends|17 ABY]]. [[Vilnau Teupt]] briefly noted the Mandalorians' role in Nouane's history in the keynote address "[[Industry, Honor, Savagery: Shaping the Mandalorian Soul]]" at [[Brentaal Academy]]'s [[Proceedings of Galactic Anthropology and History|412th Proceedings of Galactic Anthropology and History]] in [[24 ABY/Legends|24 ABY]].<ref name="EGTW" />

==Inhabitants==
Nouane was a [[Merchant/Legends|trade]] world with a long tradition of skillful statecraft. Vilnau Teupt noted both that characteristic and Nouane's "elegant" civilization as having been anathema to the Mandalorians from the era of the Mandalorian Wars.<ref name="EGTW" /> Around [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], the population of Nouane numbered between one and ten billion.<ref name="TEA" />

==Locations==
Nouane was the site of famous [[Library/Legends|libraries]] that attracted [[Artist/Legends|artists]] and [[Philosopher/Legends|philosophers]] from the Core Worlds.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Nouane was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square N-8.<ref name="TEA" />
